Game Overview

Springy Hedgehog is a animal game built around guide an eager hedgehog on a joyful bouncing journey, collecting apples while dodging falling obstacles. Enjoy intuitive controls, adorable graphics, and addictive gameplay as you tap your way through a whimsical world, mastering the rhythm of jumps and honing your strategy to achieve high scores in this charming adventure.

Springy Hedgehog keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide an eager hedgehog on a joyful bouncing journey, collecting apples while dodging falling obstacles. Enjoy intuitive controls, adorable graphics, and addictive gameplay as you tap your way through a whimsical world, mastering the rhythm of jumps and honing your strategy to achieve high scores in this charming adventure.
